description: Opaque purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and off-the-shoulder elbow-length sleeves attached to decorated shoulder straps by round jeweled gold brooches. Broad gold floral-geometric woven borders outline the neckline, straps, bodice, sleeve ends, vertical skirt strips and hem. A wide woven waist belt has a round purple-centered gold clasp and a hanging chain ornament. Cream gold-bordered wrap lies along the forearms and hangs at the sides. A below-knee skirt opening shows the lower leg and patterned closed gold-brown shoe. Pendant necklace, earrings and bracelet are visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
